response.final_text:
**Proposed disposition:** ESCALATE to Level 2, with confidence 0.70. The proposal is on file as case C-A-261020-0002, awaiting a human decision.

**What drove it:**
1. A PROP-EQ trader whose typical order size is 500 rested a 12,140 BUY at 10002 on SYN.A. That is 4.56 times the top-5 depth. The trader has no market-making registration and there was no news or risk event in the window.
2. A 364 SELL filled at 10005 at 14:10:31, with the touch up 1 tick and a round trip of +3 ticks. Two seconds later, 9,238 of the BUY was removed by MODIFY.
3. The evidence is mixed. 1,931 of the BUY executed, so it was partly genuine. There was only one cycle and no prior alerts. Reversion after the cancel could not be measured. That is why this is an escalation and not a STOR draft.

**What would change my mind:** Evidence that the BUY was a genuine accumulation (a parent order, or continued buying after the modify) with the SELL as an unrelated hedge would support closing it. A repeat of the cycle in other sessions, or reversion of the touch after the cancel, would move it to DRAFT_STOR.
